title: Blind Quiet Eye

content_blocks.text: Loss of vision in one or both eyes without ocular vascular injection or other externally apparent signs of ocular inflammation.
Results from abnormalities in focusing images on the retina, the retina detecting an image, optic nerve transmission, or the brain not interpreting images correctly.
Many causes (e.g., cataracts and progressive retinal atrophy) have a genetic basis and are often highly breed and age specific.
